competency.title: Design action selection — compute budget
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for action selection using a state-action decision log. Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: choosing an irreversible action too early

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a state-action decision log.
competency.setting_constraint: Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include resource log and quality per unit of compute.
Report goal progress and avoidable mistakes with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: choosing an irreversible action too early.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of action selection.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report goal progress and avoidable mistakes against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for choosing an irreversible action too early; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
